question: Which of the following indigenous games is included in the Khelo India Youth Games 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gatka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sports Ministry has approved the inclusion of four indigenous including Gatka, Kalaripayattu, Thang-Ta, and Mallakhamba in the Khelo India Youth Games 2021.**
 
• **Kalaripayattu**:
 
 
• It is a martial art designed for the ancient battlefield.
 
 
 
• **Gatka:**
 
 
• It is an Indian martial art associated with the Sikhs of the Punjab who practice an early variant of the martial arts.
 
 
 
• **Thang-Ta:**
 
 
• It is an Indian martial art from Manipur.
 
• It is the art of the Sword and Spear.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games:**

 
 
• It is formerly known as **Khelo India School Games**.
 
• It is the multidisciplinary grassroots games held for two categories:
 
• Under-17 years school students, Under-21 college students.
 
• First Event: 2018 hosted by Delhi, topped by Haryana.
 
• **2020 Edition: Guwahati, Assam topped by Maharashtra.**
 
• **2021 Edition: Haryana.**
